name: JFTECH
recent: JF Technology 于2026年10月29日提议每5股现有普通股派发2份免费凭单，最多发行3.88亿份凭单；11月2日提交上市申请，11月16日获Bursa Securities批准。公司近期也持续进行股份回购。最新财报（截至2026年6月30日）显示营收和净利均大幅增长。
notable: 提议每5股派2份免费凭单，最多发行3.88亿份凭单。
凭单上市申请于11月2日提交，并于11月16日获得Bursa Securities批准。
近期多次进行股份回购。
risks: 凭单行使最多可发行3.88亿股新股，可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为2740.3万令吉，环比增长18.2%，同比增长113.0%；净利为483.6万令吉，环比增长51.5%，同比增长436.7%；净利率为17.6%，高于上一季度的13.8%。

recent_en: JF Technology proposed a bonus issue of 2 free warrants for every 5 existing ordinary shares on 29 October 2026, involving up to 388 million warrants; the listing application was submitted on 2 November and approved by Bursa Securities on 16 November. The company also continued share buybacks recently. The latest financial results (period ended 30 June 2026) showed significant growth in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Proposed bonus issue of 2 free warrants for every 5 shares, up to 388 million warrants.
Warrant listing application submitted on 2 November and approved by Bursa Securities on 16 November.
risks_en: Exercise of warrants could issue up to 388 million new shares, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 27.403 million, up 18.2% QoQ and 113.0% YoY; net profit was MYR 4.836 million, up 51.5% QoQ and 436.7% YoY; net margin was 17.6%, higher than 13.8% in the previous quarter.
